symptom_short: After a transient filesystem incident, a store file that cannot be opened is left inside the region's live column-family directory: the region server reports it as un-openable on every region open and never serves or removes it

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded (private/ source/ logs/ diagnosis/); PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log. First HBase bug in this workspace; production-logs/HBase/production.log (3.06 GB, HBase 1.2.7) exists so the M3 merge applies.

JIRA HBASE-4078 'Silent Data Offlining During HDFS Flakiness' (Bug, Blocker, Closed/Fixed; reporter Nicolas Spiegelberg, assignee Pritam Damania; affects 0.89.20100924/0.90.3/0.92.0, fixVersion 0.92.0+0.94.0). Description: 'See HBASE-1436. The bug fix for this JIRA is a temporary workaround for improperly moving partially-written files from TMP into the region directory when a FS error occurs. Unfortunately, the fix is to ignore all IO exceptions, which masks off-lining due to FS flakiness.' The ticket quotes/attaches NO log snippet or stack trace (comments only reference the review board r/1327 and 'added to 89, 92, & 94' on 2011-10-13). FIX COMMIT (trunk) = df9b82c082 'HBASE-4078 Validate store files after flush/compaction' (Nicolas Spiegelberg, 2011-10-13, svn trunk@1183071; identical commits fa26da20db on 0.92 and 98cad6e708). It adds Store.validateStoreFile(Path) (open the file with new StoreFile(...).createReader(), LOG.error + rethrow on IOException, closeReader in finally) and calls it at exactly TWO production sites, in both cases BEFORE the file is moved out of the region .tmp dir: (1) Store.internalFlushCache, immediately before the flushed file is renamed into the store home dir, and (2) Store.completeCompaction, immediately before StoreFile.rename of the compaction output. It also widens compactStore/completeCompaction from private to package-private and adds TestCompaction.testCompactionWithCorruptResult. COMPANION 0.89-fb commit 790feddf2d '(HBASE-4078) Move corrupt store files out of main store file directory' saved as private/fix.0.89.diff; its message states the symptom in the reporters' own words: 'if A, B, C was compacted to D and D was corrupt, the regionserver still keeps D around but maintains the current list of store files as A, B, C. The problem now arises that when the region moves, the new RS sees A, B, C and D and tries to open D as well and gets an error. This keeps happening as the region moves around.' PRE-FIX COMMIT = 9814ffbaf0 (HBASE-4556, 2011-10-13, the parent of df9b82c082). Verified on that tree (src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/hbase/regionserver/Store.java, 1811 lines): internalFlushCache lines 521-533 do 'Path dstPath = StoreFile.getUniqueFile(fs, homedir); ... fs.rename(writer.getPath(), dstPath); ... StoreFile sf = new StoreFile(this.fs, dstPath, ...); StoreFile.Reader r = sf.createReader();' - the file is promoted into the live store dir BEFORE it is ever opened; completeCompaction lines 1221-1232 do 'if (compactedFile != null) { p = StoreFile.rename(this.fs, compactedFile.getPath(), StoreFile.getRandomFilename(fs, this.homedir)); ... result.createReader(); }' - same order. loadStoreFiles lines 269-279 is the HBASE-1436 workaround the ticket names: 'catch (IOException ioe) { LOG.warn("Failed open of " + p + "; presumption is that file was corrupted at flush and lost edits picked up by commit log replay. Verify!", ioe); continue; }' - so at every subsequent region open the promoted corrupt file is silently skipped. Repo apache/hbase, version 0.93-SNAPSHOT, default maven profile hadoop-0.20 with hadoop-core 0.20-append-r1057313 (likely needs a dep fix at M2), compileSource 1.6.

Built the pre-fix tree (9814ffbaf0, HBase 0.93-SNAPSHOT trunk of 2011-10-13) from source with Maven 3.6.3 + JDK 8 in the per-bug image clods-eval:HBase-HBase-4078 (clods-eval base + openjdk-8-jdk; JDK 11/17 refuse -source/-target 1.6, which this pom pins via compileSource). Build cmds: 'mvn -DskipTests -B package' (-> target/hbase-0.93-SNAPSHOT.jar 3.0 MB + -tests.jar 1.4 MB + target/classes) and 'mvn -B dependency:copy-dependencies -DincludeScope=test -DoutputDirectory=target/lib' (-> 62 jars incl. hadoop-core-1.0.4, hadoop-test-1.0.4, zookeeper-3.3.3), so the same tree can run a real multi-JVM HDFS+HBase deployment at M3. BUILD SUCCESS in 24 s. DEP FIXES (private/deps-fix.patch, 3 edits): (1) pom.xml <hadoop.version> 0.20-append-r1057313 -> 1.0.4 - the 0.20-append build was only ever published to people.apache.org/~rawson/repo, which is gone; 1.0.4 is the published descendant of 0.20.205 (0.20-append + append/sync) and is API-compatible with this tree. (2) pom.xml: deleted the four dead 2011 <repositories> (people.apache.org/~rawson/repo, download.java.net, repository.codehaus.org - the host no longer resolves at all and Maven aborts on it - and repository.jboss.org), keeping Apache releases + Central. (3) two javac-8 source incompatibilities in files NOT on the failure path: util/PoolMap.java 'public boolean remove(K,V)' -> 'remove(Object,Object)' (+ a (V) cast) because Java 8 added Map.remove(Object,Object), giving an erasure clash that no -source flag can suppress; and mapreduce/hadoopbackport/InputSampler.java line 344 'K[] samples = sampler.getSample(inf, job)' -> '(K[]) sampler.getSample(...)' (the raw InputFormat local erases the generic return under javac 8). Neither touches regionserver/Store.java or anything else on the failure path. Warnings only otherwise (sun.misc.Unsafe, deprecation); the antrun 'hadoop-snappy-nativelibs.tar not found' message is the pre-existing optional-native-lib task and does not fail the build.

Reproduced on a real distributed deployment built from the pre-fix tree: HDFS 1.0.4 (NameNode + 2 DataNodes, dfs.replication=2, dfs.support.append=true) as hbase.rootdir, plus HQuorumPeer, HMaster and TWO HRegionServers as separate JVMs, root logger DEBUG, the production log's own layout, table 'usertable'/family 'cf' with YCSB-shaped keys. PHASE A (healthy): 36000 rows in 4 batches with an operator flush after each, then a 4-thread mixed read/update/scan/delete workload (36988 ops, 0 failures) -> four real store files of 9956120 B each; full scan = 36000 rows. PHASE B (incident): a marker file opens a bounded window in which private/repro/DistributedFileSystemImpl.java - a DistributedFileSystem SUBCLASS installed via fs.hdfs.impl, so NO HBase source is modified and NO log/print statement is added anywhere - loses the tail of any file created under the table's region .tmp dir (the ticket's 'partially-written files ... in TMP when a FS error occurs'). Bounded to /usertable/ and 2 files per RS JVM on purpose: an unbounded run put .META. into an endless open/flush retry loop that buried the failure. Inside the window an operator major compaction wrote .tmp/65629880766638568 (39822970 B) which the FS cut to 21902633 B, and memstore flushes were cut the same way (8427637->4635200, and two 8361349->4598741 during the region open that followed). RESULT - the pre-fix code promoted EVERY short file out of .tmp into the live column-family directory and only then opened it: cf/ ends with 3355567546535143948 (21902633), 8438656049107224152 (4635200), 3784820059589198517 and 3901243280552791245 (4598741) next to the healthy 44952978 B file, and .tmp is empty (assertions 1+2 ok). Consequences in the cluster's own log: 'ERROR compactions.CompactionRequest: Compaction failed regionName=usertable,...' (the compaction died after its output was already in the store dir); 'FATAL [regionserver60021.cacheFlusher] HRegionServer: ABORTING region server ...: Replay of HLog required. Forcing server shutdown' (same for the flush); 17 'WARN regionserver.Store: Failed open of hdfs://.../cf/<file>; presumption is that file was corrupted at flush and lost edits picked up by commit log replay. Verify!' across the two RS logs, each carrying 'java.io.IOException: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Invalid HFile version: 1886087525 (expected to be between 1 and 2)' at FixedFileTrailer.readFromStream:306 <- HFile.pickReaderVersion:330 <- HFile.createReader:346 <- StoreFile$Reader.<init>:983 <- StoreFile.open:444; and 2 'ERROR handler.OpenRegionHandler: Failed open of region=usertable,...' with DroppedSnapshotException from HRegion.replayRecoveredEditsIfAny:2217. The files are never cleaned up and are silently skipped at every later open - the 0.89-fb commit's 'this keeps happening as the region moves around', reproduced by two operator 'move's in phase C. The cluster kept serving (0 client failures in every mixed phase). A final scan returns 40990 rows where 42000 keys were written; that shortfall is recorded as an OBSERVATION ONLY in reproduce.md because WAL-tail loss during log splitting on Hadoop 1.0.4 could explain part of it - the causally attributable observable is the promotion of unreadable files plus the endless 'cannot open this file' reports. Detection is silent (HDFS listings, the servers' own logs, client row counts; printed only to reproduce.sh stdout). LOGS: Log A private/symptom.orig.log = 139.7 MB / 790805 lines (785597 DEBUG, 1307 INFO, 46 WARN, 7 ERROR, 2 FATAL) as four '===== <name>__var_log_hbase__<file> =====' sections. Log B private/merged.orig.log = 3.19 GB = 11945370 production + 786959 reproduction records, produced by private/merge_logs.py (Zookeeper-1851's tool copied verbatim) with only the reproduction timestamps warped from 2026-08-17 18:43:33,544..18:48:40,160 onto the production span 2026-08-14 19:06:45,717..19:31:38,751, --interleave position (the shared HBase production log is a bundle of per-host sections, not one sorted timeline). The shared production log is never modified. Two earlier attempts were discarded and fixed, both harness bugs, not HBase bugs: (1) loseTail called the 2-arg super.create, which FileSystem dispatches back through the overridden 7-arg create -> infinite recursion/StackOverflowError; (2) an unscoped, unbounded incident also cut short .META.'s open-time flushes, putting .META. into a retry storm.

Anonymized per METHODOLOGY M4/sec.6 and regenerated BOTH logs from the anonymized build. (a) BUG-ID SCRUB: HBASE-4078 appears nowhere; the only Apache JIRA id in the failure-path source (a comment 'after data loss in hdfs for whatever reason (upgrade, etc.): HBASE-646' in loadStoreFiles) was rewritten away. (b) DISTINCTIVE TERM: none exists in the pre-fix tree - the term a reader would grep ('validateStoreFile', from the fix commit title 'Validate store files after flush/compaction') is introduced BY the fix. (c) FAILURE-PATH TYPE/METHOD RENAMES: class Store -> FamilyStore (Store.java -> FamilyStore.java) - it holds BOTH root-cause sites and the symptom site and is the logger name on every failure-path line; plus the case-identifying method names internalFlushCache -> writeSnapshotFile, completeCompaction -> installCompactionResult, loadStoreFiles -> openStoreFiles, compactStore -> mergeStoreFiles, and HStore -> FamilyStore (the class's historical name, left in javadoc/comments). DELIBERATELY KEPT as generic (they carry no case-identifying information and appear verbatim in the production log): StoreFile(.Reader), StoreFlusher, HRegion, HRegionServer, MemStoreFlusher, CompactSplitThread, CompactionRequest, OpenRegionHandler, HFile, HFileReaderV2, FixedFileTrailer, DroppedSnapshotException. (d) LOG-STATEMENT REWRITES (17 entries, one longest-key-first pass): the symptom line 'Failed open of X; presumption is that file was corrupted at flush and lost edits picked up by commit log replay. Verify!' -> 'Cannot read X; leaving it out of this column family's file list. Check the file.'; 'Renaming flushed file at' -> 'Moving new store file'; 'Failed move of compacted file' -> 'Could not place merged file'; 'Compaction failed' -> 'Merge failed'; 'Failed open of region=' -> 'Could not bring region online: region='; 'Starting/Completed [major] compaction of' -> 'Beginning/Finished [major] merge of'; 'Replay of HLog required. Forcing server shutdown' -> 'Write-ahead log must be replayed; shutting this server down'; etc. The ticket quotes no log text, so the whole failure-path literal set was rewritten rather than just a quoted snippet. 156 substitutions in 28 files; the anonymized tree at repos/hbase4078-anon BUILDS ('mvn -Dmaven.test.skip=true package' BUILD SUCCESS - note maven-compiler-plugin 2.0.2 cannot parse javac 8's bootstrap-classpath warning and fails the first whole-tree compile, so anonymize.sh compiles twice, exactly as the pre-fix tree needs at M2) and still REPRODUCES: 4 files cut short in .tmp (39822970->21902633 compaction output, 8916503->4904076 and 2x 8883353->4885844 flush outputs), ALL FOUR promoted into the live cf/ directory, .tmp empty, 1 'Merge failed', 1 regionserver abort, 3 DroppedSnapshotException, 42 'Invalid HFile version' and 17 'Cannot read ...' reports across region opens. source/ = the 13 files of the completed causal chain (FamilyStore, StoreFile, StoreFlusher, HRegion, HRegionServer, MemStoreFlusher, CompactSplitThread, CompactionRequest, OpenRegionHandler, HFile, HFileReaderV2, FixedFileTrailer, DroppedSnapshotException). logs/repro.log (Log A) = 133 MB / 751070 lines written directly by the anonymized binaries. logs/symptom.log (Log B, LLM-facing) = 3.19 GB = 11945370 production + 747348 reproduction records; merge_logs.py --rename applies the SAME vocabulary to the production stream (HStore/loadStoreFiles/internalFlushCache -> the anonymized names, the compaction phrases, and two prose lower-casings) so the reproduction lines are not the only differently-worded ones. The shared production log is never modified. Check the file.' + 'java.io.IOException: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Invalid HFile version: 1652127846 (expected to be between 1 and 2)' at FixedFileTrailer.readFromStream:306 <- HFile.pickReaderVersion:330 <- HFile.createReader:346 <- StoreFile$Reader.<init>:983 <- StoreFile.open:444 <- StoreFile.createReader:517 <- FamilyStore.openStoreFiles:273 <- FamilyStore.<init>:215 <- HRegion.instantiateHStore:2409). Only the record's leading absolute timestamp is elided, because it would act as an exact-position pointer into the 3.19 GB log; every other character is verbatim and greppable (the pasted 'Cannot read ...' line occurs 5x in logs/symptom.log, 'Invalid HFile version: 1652127846' 14x). No >>> SYMPTOM marker and no line number, per M5 step 1(b) for a merged log. DELIBERATELY ABSENT (anti-cheat): the trigger (nothing about a filesystem incident or partially written files), the mechanism, the at-fault class/method/branch, and - most important for this bug - any mention of the two operations that select the failure (the compaction and the flush) or of the regionserver abort and the failed compaction that accompany it; naming those would hand over the shape of the answer, since the two root-cause sites ARE the flush promotion and the compaction promotion. The LLM must grep the merged production log for the rest itself. ground_truth.md derived from private/fix.diff with BOTH the real names and the anonymized ones plus a translation table (M5 step 2): site A = Store.internalFlushCache lines 521-533 (= FamilyStore.writeSnapshotFile) where fs.rename(writer.getPath(), dstPath) promotes the flushed file and sf.createReader() only reads it afterwards; site B = Store.completeCompaction lines 1221-1232 (= FamilyStore.installCompactionResult) where StoreFile.rename(...) inside 'if (compactedFile != null)' promotes the compaction output and result.createReader() only reads it afterwards; the wrong condition at both = the move is guarded only by 'did the rename succeed' / 'was anything written', never by 'can the file be opened', and the open happens after the move so a bad file is already a permanent member of the store dir. The consequence site (loadStoreFiles' catch(IOException){continue;} = openStoreFiles) is recorded as NOT a pass, since the fix does not touch it. Pre-registered bar per sec.8/sec.10: BOTH sites + the exact missing-validation condition; sub-scores site_a/site_b/condition_stated/symptom_site_only are recorded per run so alternative bars are auditable without a re-run. M5 gate (private/verify_anon.py, streaming pass): source/, logs/repro.log, the whole 3.19 GB logs/symptom.log and symptom.md carry 0 hits for the bug id and every original failure-path type/method/literal; the only survivor is the bare number 4078 as an ordinary counter value (RPC call ids, HDFS packet seqnos, ZooKeeper xids).
